span.p:
KV per token = 2 x 48 x 8 x 128 x 2 bytes = 192.0 KiB exactly
24.0 GiB at 128k context - tag [M]

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fast tier flat at ~200 GB/s out to at least 62 GiB
BIOS UMA carve-out 96 GB - tag [M], one run per arm

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
a single tensor of 32 GiB or more hard-hangs at 0 CPU
31 GiB copies cleanly at 199.9 GB/s - tag [M]

div.style: color: rgb(183, 28, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SDPA retains the score matrix: 147.2 bytes per T squared
AOTriton path is 6.6 and stays OFF by default - tag [M]

decode arithmetic intensity is 2G / dtype bytes
